prompts.jack: Create one production game cinematic background for StudentOS Halloween, portrait 1024x1536. Premium painterly cinematic dark fantasy with realistic stone/wood textures and controlled atmospheric light, matching a haunted ship illustration in deep midnight indigo, soft violet mist and small colored glows. NOT pixel art, NOT flat vector, NOT a poster, no UI, no lettering, no watermark, no logo, no people or students, no weapons held toward camera, no gore, no laser beams. A clear readable main scene with layered depth, not cluttered. Keep the upper third dark and quiet for an HTML caption and work card. The scene's receiving focal point should be near the horizontal center and 65 percent down the image, so an animated paper can fly into it. All detail should remain legible on a phone. No collage or panels. Scene: Jack's Hollow, an ominous abandoned pumpkin farm and crooked small village. A wet winding path through twisted pumpkin vines leads to a single imposing carved pumpkin on an old tree stump at center lower-middle. Its mouth has a restrained amber glow and reads as the receiving opening. Bare twisted tree and wooden fences frame the scene. A few low pumpkin lights, distant dark village roofs and a pale moon through clouds. Burnt orange, antique gold, deep brown against midnight blue. Eerie, elegant, haunting, not cute; no scattered excessive lanterns.
